gotchas: /upgrade is a three-step flow (Account Creation, Plan Selection, Payment Completion) and opens a "Sign in to your account" dialog first. Email + Enter (a top-level Continue click times out), then password + Enter.
After the password a visible reCAPTCHA challenge appeared on both runs (2026-10-06 and 2026-10-07): an account-owner handoff. Once solved, reload /upgrade signed in.
Choose Your Plan shows three visible "Select" buttons; the first was used.

Payment: click the card option (text matching /card/) to reveal Stripe split iframes. Only the card-number iframe is visible at first; the expiration and CVC iframes are attached but hidden until a number is typed. Fill expiry marked as a card field so it moves after the CVC: number, CVC, then expiry.
Verified 2026-10-07 through the proxy (US tunnel) with the public test card under a verification-only key: number, CVC and expiry filled, no invalid state. Stopped before payment was submitted.
